operations.currentBehaviour: Renders a 'not installed' block when the localStorage installed[] array lacks 'ITAM'. defaultInstalled is ['CRM','HR'] (workspace.tsx:729) so a fresh workspace always sees the gate.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server-side entitlement check per tenant; unentitled requests get 403 from the API, not just a hidden screen.
operations.authorization: Any tenant member; entitlement resolved server-side
operations.validation: appCode must be an installed, non-disabled app for the tenant

operations.currentBehaviour: Link navigates to /app/marketplace.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Unchanged; deep-link back to the ITAM card after install.

operations.currentBehaviour: router.push of ?tab=<id>; the dashboard tab pushes the bare path. Unknown tab values silently fall back to dashboard (line 24).
operations.requiredBehaviour: Keep URL-addressable tabs; unknown tab -> 404 or explicit redirect, not a silent fallback.

operations.currentBehaviour: Renders 'Trial · {trialDaysLeft} days left' from the hardcoded constant TRIAL_DAYS = 13 (workspace.tsx:67); it never counts down.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Derive from the tenant subscription's trial_ends_at; show expired state.

operations.currentBehaviour: assets.filter(stage !== 'Retired').length computed in the browser over the localStorage array.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server aggregate scoped to tenant+company, excluding retired and archived units.

operations.currentBehaviour: assetRequests.filter(status === 'Pending').length; counts every tenant request, not those awaiting this user.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Two figures: total pending and pending on the viewer's approval level.
operations.authorization: Asset viewer; approver figure scoped to the caller

operations.currentBehaviour: daysUntil(warrantyEnd) < 0 evaluated with new Date() in browser-local time; blank warranty yields Infinity and is silently excluded.
operations.requiredBehaviour: SQL predicate warranty_end < current_date in the tenant timezone; blank warranty reported separately as 'unknown'.

operations.currentBehaviour: 0 <= daysUntil(warrantyEnd) <= warrantyAlertDays, where the window is the hardcoded constant 60 (assetData.ts:118).
operations.requiredBehaviour: Window must be tenant-configurable settings, not a compile-time constant.
operations.validation: window is a positive integer number of days

operations.currentBehaviour: stage === 'Issued' && assignedTo.endsWith('(leaver)') — employment status inferred from a suffix inside a display name. assignedTo is never set anywhere, so this tile is permanently 0.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Join active assignments to employment status on the identity record; no string suffix.

operations.currentBehaviour: Renders every expiring asset with no cap, no ordering and no link to the unit.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Paginated, ordered by warranty_end ascending, each row linking to the asset detail route.

operations.currentBehaviour: Lists name + assignedTo string; permanently empty for the reason above.
operations.requiredBehaviour: List with custodian, last working day and a 'start recovery' action.

operations.currentBehaviour: No-op — tiles are plain divs with no onClick and no href, so a non-zero count cannot be opened.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Each tile links to the register or requests list pre-filtered to that population.

operations.currentBehaviour: useMemo filter over the whole localStorage array; no pagination, no sort, no server call. Empty state at line 339.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server list with cursor pagination, sort, and the filter set below applied in SQL; tenant+company scoped.
operations.authorization: Asset viewer; rows restricted to the caller's tenant and permitted companies
operations.validation: limit<=100; unknown filter keys rejected

operations.currentBehaviour: setState only; options come from the asset_types taxonomy, compared against asset.type by string equality.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Filter by assetTypeId; selection persisted in the URL so the view is shareable.
operations.validation: assetTypeId must exist in the tenant's asset_types taxonomy

operations.currentBehaviour: setState only. The option list is DISTINCT over the free-text asset.project strings of loaded rows (line 143), so it changes as rows are added and a typo becomes a permanent 'project'.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Filter by projectId against a real project list.

operations.currentBehaviour: setState only; chips for 'All' plus the six stages.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server filter on stage; multi-select.
operations.validation: stage must be one of the six enum values

operations.currentBehaviour: countFor() counts the FULL asset array and ignores the active type/project/search filters, so the chip numbers contradict the table below them.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Faceted counts computed over the same predicate as the list.

operations.currentBehaviour: Client substring match over name + tagNo + assignedTo, lowercased, no debounce.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server search over name, tag, serial and custodian with a trigram or tsvector index.
operations.validation: q length <= 200

operations.currentBehaviour: Triggers a Blob download named asset-register.csv built with join(','). No quoting, no escaping and no formula guard, so any name containing a comma corrupts the row — even though src/lib/csv.ts already exports csvCell()/downloadCsv() that do this correctly.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Server-generated export over the permitted, filtered set using the shared CSV writer; record the export in the audit trail.
operations.authorization: Asset viewer; export scoped to the caller's visible rows
operations.validation: Filter snapshot validated server-side; formula-injection escaping mandatory

operations.currentBehaviour: FileReader + row.split(',') with the header row dropped blindly, then one addAsset() per row into localStorage. Its column order (name,type,stage,project,purchase,warranty) does NOT match the exporter's (asset,tag_no,type,stage,project,purchase,assigned_to,warranty_end), so re-importing this screen's own export shifts every column. No validation of stage or type, no dedup, no rollback.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Staged upload -> parse with the quoted parser -> validate each row against taxonomies and the stage enum -> show a mapping/error preview -> atomic commit with an AssetImportBatch row.
operations.validation: MIME + size checks; header mapping; type and stage must resolve; reject duplicate tags/serials

operations.currentBehaviour: setNote() with the canned string 'No purchase receipts are waiting. Assets appear here once a PO is received.' No purchasing data is consulted — there is no PO entity in the codebase.
operations.requiredBehaviour: List received PO lines awaiting tagging and create one tagged unit per received quantity, linked to the PO line. BLOCKED until a purchasing source is chosen.

operations.currentBehaviour: setOpen(true) — opens the New asset dialog. The draft's default type is types[0] evaluated at first render, so it goes stale if taxonomies change in another tab.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Open a form seeded from a fresh server-fetched taxonomy.

operations.currentBehaviour: addAsset() -> workspace.tsx:1712 writes the row plus an audit row into localStorage. Only name is required (disabled={!draft.name.trim()}); assignedTo is hardcoded null; the stage select permits creating a unit directly as 'Issued' or even 'Retired'; warrantyEnd may be any past date; no custom fields, make, model or mode-of-purchase are collected.
operations.requiredBehaviour: POST validating name, assetTypeId, stage (creation restricted to In Stock unless a custody record accompanies it), warranty dates, project/PO references and all required custom fields; emit an AssetEvent 'created'.
operations.validation: name 1..200 non-blank; assetTypeId exists; stage in enum; warrantyEnd >= acquiredOn; unique tag; unknown fields rejected

operations.currentBehaviour: seq = count of existing assets of that type + 1, padded to 4, prefixed by the taxonomy tagPrefix or 'AST-'. Deleting an asset and creating another of the same type re-issues a tag that already existed, and no uniqueness check exists.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Allocate from a locked sequence row inside the create transaction; enforce UNIQUE(tenant_id, company_id, tag_no).
operations.validation: Unique violation retried, never silently reused

operations.currentBehaviour: updateAsset(id,{stage}) -> workspace.tsx:1736 overwrites stage in place. Any stage may be chosen from any other, including 'Issued' with no request and no custodian, and 'Retired' with no reason. The previous stage is lost; the audit row stores the raw UUID.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Replace the free dropdown with guarded transitions (issue / return / send for repair / close repair / start check / retire), each writing an AssetEvent with from/to, actor and reason, and each enforcing its precondition.
operations.authorization: Asset admin; issue additionally requires an approved request
operations.validation: Transition must be legal from the current stage; 'Issued' requires an approved request and a custodian; 'Retired' requires a retirement reason

operations.currentBehaviour: removeAsset(id) -> workspace.tsx:1746 hard-deletes the row from the array immediately, with no confirmation dialog and no undo. The unit, its tag and everything that would have been its custody and financial history vanish; the audit row records only the UUID of something that no longer exists.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Replace with archive/void: set archived_at, keep the tag reserved, keep all events and assignments. Permit true deletion only for a never-issued unit created in error, and only with an explicit reason recorded. This is the Loop 29 release gate.
operations.authorization: Asset admin; hard delete restricted to tenant owner
operations.validation: Refuse archive while an active assignment exists; require a reason

operations.currentBehaviour: No-op — the row has no link, no click target and there is no asset detail route in src/app. A unit cannot be opened.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Detail surface showing identity, custody timeline, service history, warranty and custom fields.

operations.currentBehaviour: Missing — stage is the only editable attribute after creation; name, type, project, PO reference and warranty cannot be corrected at all.
operations.requiredBehaviour: Full edit form with optimistic-concurrency (updatedAt / version) and field-level audit.
operations.validation: Same as create; version conflict returns 409

openQuestions: Stage semantics: what operationally distinguishes 'Allocated' from 'Issued', and what puts a unit into 'Awaiting check' (return inspection? periodic audit?). Which stages may hold a custodian, and which transitions are legal from which? The prototype allows every stage to follow every other.

Authoritative issue rule: the requests pane states an asset cannot be issued without a matching approved request, while the register lets anyone set 'Issued' directly. Which is the real rule, and is there a break-glass path for emergency issue?

Approval ladder semantics: within one level, must every listed approver agree or does any one suffice? Does a rejection at level 2 end the request or return it to level 1? Is there an SLA, escalation or delegation?
Approver identity: what does the seeded role 'Manager (unknown)' resolve to, and what does 'By Department head' resolve to given that no department exists on any record in the codebase?
Self-approval: may a requester approve their own request (the UI currently allows it and the copy appears to endorse it), and may an Asset admin approve unilaterally regardless of the ladder?

The 'Issued' request status has no control that sets it: who performs issue, is a specific unit chosen at that moment, and must that unit be In Stock and of the requested type? Must a request name an asset type at all?
Request withdrawal/cancellation by the requester is absent from both the UI and the status vocabulary — is it in scope, and what status value should it use?

Asset type 'config' (the ⚙ 3 badge, hasConfig/configCount): what are these configuration rows? Specification templates, accessory bundles, approval overrides? Nothing in the source says, and only a count is rendered.

Four taxonomies ship empty and are read by nothing: 'models', 'warranty', 'numbering', 'notification'. What entries and what additional columns do they carry? In particular, what are the numbering rules ('Numbering & Naming') — prefix only, or per-company/per-year sequences with a reset policy?

Should make, model and mode of purchase (Purchase/Lease/Rental) be captured on an asset? Their taxonomies are seeded but no form, filter or report references them. Lease/rental in particular would imply terms and end dates the model does not have.
'Department usage' report: no department attribute exists on any asset, assignment or user. Where does department come from — the custodian's HR record, the project, or the owning company?
'Asset ledger' report: is it a custody/event ledger or a financial one (cost, depreciation, book value)? The columns cannot be inferred from the source.

'Support notes' report and the Support taxonomies (Reasons, Notification): is there a distinct asset service/repair record, or should these link to tickets in the Support & Ticketing app? What does the 'Notification' taxonomy configure — recipients, channels, events?

Is asset cost, depreciation or book value in scope at all? There is no money field anywhere in this domain today, yet the Loop 29 gate speaks of 'financial history'. If yes: what depreciation method, and per company or per tenant?
'Receive from purchase': which purchasing source feeds it? Purchase & Payables exists only as a marketplace card, and no PO entity exists in the codebase.
How does a user account link to an employee record? The My Asset empty state instructs the user to ask an admin to link it, but no employee identity, link feature or admin screen exists.

Leaver detection currently depends on a '(leaver)' suffix inside a display name. What is the authoritative source of employment status, and what should the offboarding recovery flow actually do (auto-raise a Return request? block the exit checklist?).
Retirement with reason 'Sold' or 'Donated': are proceeds, buyer and disposal documents recorded, and does disposal post anywhere financially?
Custom fields: are they global or per asset type? Where do options for the 'select' type come from? Are they editable after values exist, and what happens to values when a field is deleted?
Change History: what exactly is revertible — configuration only, or record changes too — and at what granularity? What does 'reverted' mean for an entry that has since been superseded?
Taxonomy scope: are master taxonomies tenant-wide or per company? Assets are expected to be company-scoped, so a shared taxonomy with per-company tag sequences needs confirmation.
Agent controls: is 'Pause AI agents' genuinely tenant-wide as its label says (it is stored per app today, with a duplicate copy in POS), and is the auto-pause credit threshold per app or per tenant?
Should ITAM be installed by default? defaultInstalled is ['CRM','HR'], so every fresh workspace lands on the not-installed gate for this app.
The warranty alert window is the hardcoded constant 60 days. Should it be tenant-configurable, and per asset type?
Who may see other people's requests and the detail text they contain? Today every signed-in user sees every request in the tenant, including the free-text justification.
